high_level_description: The image is a split-screen of two nearly identical photos featuring the same person. The individual has long, dark brown hair that falls over their shoulders. They are wearing large, round glasses with black frames and have a light makeup look, including eyeliner and eyeshadow. Their lips are painted a soft pink color. In both photos, the person is wearing a black top with white polka dots. They are accessorized with a thin gold necklace and a pair of dangling earrings.
